content: If you are in the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. Similarly, if you are in Canada, consult your doctor for guidance on side effects. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. For less urgent cases, contact a poison control center without delay. Residents in the United States can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Instead, ensure proper disposal of the product when it has expired or is no longer needed. The information provided here was last updated in May 2024.
